title: Replit Agent moved from $0.25 flat checkpoints to effort-based pricing
detail: The Agent now prices each task by the time and computation it decides the task required, bundled into a single checkpoint, instead of splitting work into fixed $0.25 checkpoints. Rolled out to new users immediately and reached existing Core and Teams subscribers from July 1, 2026.
impact: You cannot see the price before committing to a task, and the cost lands after the run. Users report being billed on runs that hung or errored. Simple edits can land under $0.25; heavy tasks run well above it.
